head: Clicks Communicator delay: keyboard phone now ships in 2027
dek: Clicks has moved deliveries of its $649 Communicator keyboard phone from December to late January and February 2027. People who ordered before 20 November get a pair of 3.5mm wired headphones in the box.
details: Clicks blames a shortage of a special fiberglass cloth for the phone's 12-layer circuit board; Android Headlines reports that only six factories make it. About two-thirds of existing pre-orders should ship before the Chinese New Year factory break, the rest at the end of February. Orders placed from 20 November on are expected in the second quarter of 2027. The design is finished and FCC certification is on track, according to the report.
where: Pre-orders of the Clicks Communicator; first deliveries end of January 2027
means: If you pre-ordered a Communicator, expect it about one to two months later than planned; if you order now, expect it in spring 2027.
todo: Nothing to do if you already ordered: the headphones come with orders placed before 20 November.
